questions.q: How did Silver react in the first moment after seeing the empty pit?
choices: He kept his head and changed his plan at once
He went white and fainted from the shock of it
He jumped down into the pit and began to dig
He blamed Jim for it and struck him with his crutch
questions.evidence: he kept his head, found his temper, and changed his plan

questions.q: What did Silver secretly hand to Jim?
choices: A double-barrelled pistol
A small bag of gold coins
A sharp knife with a bone handle
The brass compass from his pocket
questions.evidence: And he passed me a double-barrelled pistol.

questions.q: What did Jim whisper to Silver after seeing him move away from the pirates?
choices: So you've changed sides again
Thank you for saving my life
Let's run for the boats now
Where have they put the treasure?

questions.q: What did Morgan find while digging in the pit?
choices: A two-guinea piece
A heavy bar of gold
A skeleton's skull
A torn scrap of map

questions.q: What did George Merry accuse Silver of?
choices: Knowing all along that the treasure was gone
Stealing the two-guinea piece and hiding it
Being afraid of Flint's ghost
Letting Jim slip away to warn the doctor
questions.evidence: that man there knew it all along

questions.q: What happened just as Merry raised his arm to lead a charge?
choices: Three musket-shots flashed out of the thicket
Silver threw down his crutch and ran for the trees
Jim fired his pistol into the air as a warning
The other pirates threw down their arms and gave up
questions.evidence: three musket-shots flashed out of the thicket

questions.q: Who came out of the nutmeg-trees with smoking muskets?
choices: The doctor, Gray and Ben Gunn
The squire and Captain Smollett
Three pirates left on the ship
Israel Hands and Tom Morgan
questions.evidence: the doctor, Gray, and Ben Gunn joined us

questions.q: Why did the doctor hurry everyone forward after the shooting?
choices: To get between the surviving pirates and the boats
To find the rest of the treasure before dark
To catch Ben Gunn before he ran off
To reach the stockade in time to fetch the food
questions.evidence: We must head 'em off the boats

questions.q: Who had really dug up and moved Flint's treasure?
choices: Ben Gunn
Captain Smollett
Doctor Livesey
George Merry
questions.evidence: he had found the treasure; he had dug it up

questions.q: Where had Ben Gunn hidden the treasure?
choices: In his cave on the two-pointed hill
Under the floor of the old stockade
Down in the hold of the HISPANIOLA
In a new pit beneath the tall pine
questions.evidence: a cave he had on the two-pointed hill

questions.q: Why had the doctor given Silver the chart?
choices: It was useless now, and it bought them a safe move to the cave
Silver had tricked him into handing it over with a false story
He wanted the pirates to find the gold and leave them in peace
He had lost all interest in the treasure after the battle
questions.evidence: given him the chart, which was now useless

questions.q: How did Ben Gunn slow down the pirates before the doctor arrived?
choices: He played on their fears with Flint's song and words
He set fire to the dry woods all along their path
He crept down to the shore and stole their boats
He fired warning shots from behind the rocks
questions.evidence: it had occurred to him to work upon the superstitions of his former shipmates

questions.q: What did they find just inside the mouth of North Inlet?
choices: The HISPANIOLA, floating by herself
The pirates' old camp in the marsh
A second wrecked ship on the rocks
The squire waiting for them in a boat
questions.evidence: what should we meet but the HISPANIOLA, cruising by herself?

questions.q: The squire calls Silver "a prodigious villain and imposter." What does prodigious mean here?
choices: Enormous, very great
Small and harmless
Clever and very kind
Young and foolish
questions.evidence: you're a prodigious villain and imposter

questions.q: What did Jim see in the far corner of the cave?
choices: Heaps of coin and bars of gold
The bones of Flint's six men
The pirates' black flag, folded
Ben Gunn's goats, penned in
questions.evidence: great heaps of coin and quadrilaterals built of bars of gold

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: The mutineers are beaten, and Jim learns Ben Gunn moved the treasure to his cave
Silver turns on Jim, grabs the treasure and escapes alone to the HISPANIOLA
Jim and Silver are forced to fight the doctor and Gray at the empty pit
The pirates race back to the shore, retake the HISPANIOLA and sail away
questions.evidence: Ben Gunn, the half-idiot maroon, was the hero from beginning to end
